answer: Sybils can wander freely with cheap keys, but forging thousands of distinct valid sonnets and locking collateral costs real compute and capital per identity, so diluted rewards rarely repay the attacker's spend. Each agent must bind a small stake to a public reputation slot thread and post a unique proof-of-work sonnet, a fourteen-line verse hashed against the epoch challenge. In practice, sa0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
